description: Erection of a single storey rear extension following demolition of the extisting extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( PL(00)001; PL(03)X009; PL(03)X010; PL(03)X011; PL(03)009; PL(05)X002; PL(00)002; Design and Access Statement; Received 11 March 2020
PL(003)011 B; PL(03)010 C; Received 06 May 2020
PL(05)001 D; PL(05)002 C; Received 27 May 2020 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The height of the proposed extension shall be no greater than the existing extension and measure 2.80m from the existing decked platform found on site.
